item.title: I’m new with R
item.description: I’m a PhD student requested to learn how to run statistical analysis (Regressions, correlations.. etc) with ‘R’. I’m completely new to statistical softwares. May I ask how I can started with this. What do I need to learn first?. Unfortunately my background is not related to programming. Thank you for helping me. 🙏🏻
